claims.summary: astrid:llm is a non-destructive scanner: scan_known_model_control_markers (L114) preserves a known marker in `remainder` only when it has valid reference syntax, copying all other bytes byte-exact.
claims.disposition: Verified from complete source (SHA 902a0358; lines 1-400 read in full). scan_known_model_control_markers copies every non-marker byte byte-exact (L133-140) and pushes a known marker into remainder only when reference_syntax.is_some() (L129-131); reference syntax = a quoted/grouped delimiter pair (L153-229) or an allowlisted relation verb (L64-86). 68 marker tests pass.

claims.summary: Likely snag: first_word_after (L89) uses split_whitespace + a manual alphanumeric trim_matches; a marker followed by a soft hyphen / non-standard whitespace could fail to isolate the verb, returning None and stripping the marker (L129-130).
claims.disposition: Mechanism verified; the 'followed by whitespace/soft-hyphen' framing does not fail. split_whitespace (L91) separates U+00A0-class White_Space; the edge trim (L92) strips a leading soft hyphen (U+00AD)/ZWNBSP, so the verb is still isolated and the marker preserved (already grounded for twin 1786936281). The genuine trim_matches limit is edge-only: an INTERNAL soft hyphen inside the verb blocks the exact match -> None -> marker stripped (fails closed, safe). Added a focused regression grounding both boundaries.

claims.summary: Test 1: exact_reference_delimiter_syntax (L199) should identify QuotedExactKnownToken for non-standard supported quotes like the corner brackets (L168) around a known marker.
claims.disposition: Verified: the corner-bracket pair is an ExactKnownMarkerReferenceContext::QuotedExactKnownToken entry (L168) in exact_reference_delimiter_pair, consumed by exact_reference_delimiter_syntax (L199). Already covered by control_marker_cleanup_preserves_non_ascii_matching_quote_pairs (tests.rs L2301) which wraps <end_of_turn> in the corner brackets and asserts quoted_reference_occurrences==1; passes.

claims.summary: Test 2: a marker followed by a verb NOT in followed_by_explicit_exact_token_relation (L64-86) should be excluded from the remainder output of scan_known_model_control_markers (L143).
claims.disposition: Verified: a marker with no delimiter context and an unlisted following verb gets reference_syntax None (L49-60) and is not pushed to remainder (L129). Already covered by control_marker_cleanup_distinguishes_allowlisted_is_from_unlisted_acts (acts -> removed), ..._to_implies, ..._to_contains, and the punctuation_boundary only-punctuation fail-closed case; all pass.
